scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && concurrently -k -n api,h5 "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:client:h5"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/server build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/worker build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/client build:h5 && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/admin build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/server test && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/worker test && node --test tests/cloudflare-preview-api.test.cjs tests/cloudflare-supabase-api.test.cjs tests/cloudflare-worker-entry.test.cjs
scripts.build:worker: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/client build:h5 && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.145.0 deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy:worker: pnpm --filter @yinghuo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @yinghuo/client build:h5 && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.145.0 deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
